title: Return-to-Brand Mileage Credit for Kestrel Advantage Balloon Customers
content:
**Loyalty terms — return-to-brand miles.** A customer who returns a vehicle under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract and stays with Kestrel around the return has miles forgiven on the excess mileage charge:

- a customer holding an active **Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease** whose lease date falls within 60 calendar days before or after the return date has **1500 miles** forgiven;
- a customer holding no such lease but holding an active **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract** whose contract date falls within that span has **1000 miles** forgiven;
- any other customer has no return-to-brand miles.

The holdings read are the customer's lease records (status and lease date) and new-vehicle retail contract records (status and contract date). Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one; a lease or contract dated exactly 60 calendar days before or after the return date is within the span.

## Decision table

| Active lease dated within 60 days of the return | Active new-vehicle retail contract dated within 60 days | Miles forgiven |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | 1500 |
| No | Yes | 1000 |
| No | No | None |

## Hypothetical cases

- Return on the 1st of a month; an active lease dated 60 days later: 1500 miles. Dated 61 days later: outside the span.
- An active lease dated 200 days before the return and an active new-vehicle retail contract dated 10 days after it: 1000 miles.
- A pre-owned retail contract dated near the return does not enter this credit.
